prompt.description: Explicitly admitted instruction snapshot; never inferred from file reads or tool output. Content carries the exact text.

scope.description: shared instructions copied to fresh children, or local instructions for this transcript

source.description: Source label or canonical file path; descriptive, not reread at delivery

revision.description: SHA-256 of the admitted text when loaded from a file

context_output.description: Immutable full tool-result snapshot, scoped by originating transcript entry.

reader.description: Caller principal permitted to inspect a snapshot kept by a multi-user host; omitted when the graph itself provides its access boundary.
